verdict.rationale: Targeted release announcements are a fair capability for a product-management platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no release-notes or announcement feature, and nothing about segmenting recipients by user attributes. Releases, release groups, and user/company records appear only as product data entities, which are adjacent building blocks rather than targeted release-note delivery.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can segment product release announcements by user attributes to send targeted release notes
